name: 1Password Agent Hooks
summary: 1Password's MIT-licensed hooks for Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Windsurf that validate 1Password setup (such as mounted .env files) before agents run shell or tool commands.
description: Official repository 1Password/agent-hooks (MIT; use of 1Password APIs and services through it is governed by the 1Password API Terms of Service; not archived). Hooks fire on agent events such as before shell or tool use to validate and verify 1Password configuration so commands run with the secrets they expect, for example `1password-validate-mounted-env-files`, which validates mounted .env files from 1Password Environments. Supported agents per the README: Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Windsurf (Cascade). Install: an install script (`./install.sh --agent <agent>`) builds a bundle you copy into a project or user config and register in the agent's hooks file (for example .cursor/hooks.json or .claude/settings.json), or use the plugin routes listed in the README. These are scripts that run on your machine at agent events, so review them before enabling (editorial). Telemetry disclosure: the hooks emit opt-in telemetry (install method, which agents trigger hooks and similar); events are written only if ~/.config/1Password/telemetry-enabled exists, which the 1Password desktop app creates or removes according to its product-telemetry setting; the desktop app forwards the events, the file is capped at 1 MB, and failures are ignored. Turning off product telemetry in 1Password Settings stops the hooks writing. Free software; a 1Password account is separate. Nothing was installed or run and no 1Password account was used.

agent_access.notes: Local hook scripts installed into agent config; no hosted endpoint and no MCP server. Opt-in telemetry only when the 1Password desktop app's data-usage setting creates ~/.config/1Password/telemetry-enabled. Not installed or run.
